title: Wave-5 v5.1 ledger schema (HV1 real Layer-3 + HV2 WNN sweep + MV1a determinism replay + MV2 R parity + MV3 chromVAR/TF/GWAS + POLISH PDF)
description: Schema for Wave-5.6 plan v5.1 ledger entries. plan_revision enum restricted to {v5.1}; v4.x and v5.0 records cannot pass enum (three-way mutual rejection impossible-by-construction). Additive on top of v5.0 fields; new fields per plan §11. parent_v50_ledger_sha required for provenance chain (mirrors v5.0 parent_v42_ledger_sha pattern per Arch-1-#4).

run_id.description: Run-id of the new v5.1 canonical run (format: <ISO-stamp>-<short-sha>).

plan_revision.description: v5.1 enum strictly excludes v4.x and v5.0 to enforce three-way mutual rejection.

parent_canonical_run_id.description: Run-id of the parent v4.2 canonical run. Expected: 20260516T0931Z-d192836f1bb0.

parent_v42_ledger_sha.description: SHA-256 of the v4.2 ledger file (binding provenance chain).

parent_v50_ledger_sha.description: SHA-256 of the v5.0 ledger file (v5.0 -> v5.1 provenance chain per Arch-1-#4).

historical_reproduction_rate.description: Side-by-side v5.0.4 baseline and v5.1 measured reproduction rates per Principle #2.

wnn_sweep_search_space_sha.description: SHA-256 of committed search_space.json per HARKing safeguard #7.

wnn_sweep_aggregation_rule_sha.description: SHA-256 of committed aggregation_rule.json per HARKing safeguard #7.

wnn_selected_config.description: Selected configuration dict from WNN sweep (resolution, n_neighbors, weight_strategy, knn_pruning).

wnn_fix_status.description: Outcome of WNN ARI fix attempt per AC-V51-HV2-3.

wnn_post_fix_ari.description: Post-fix ARI vs Trevino seurat_clusters; null if INCOMPLETE.

mv1_input_mode.description: Whether MV1 used raw FASTQ (MV1b, Wave-6) or processed count matrices (MV1a, default).

mv2_parity_status.description: Overall MV2 R-Python parity result. PASS-CONTRACT-ONLY means the bundle/export contract passed but full analytical R parity was not executed.

chromvar_lib_pinned.description: Pinned chromVAR Python library name + version (or 'rpy2_bridge') per pre-mortem Scenario 3.

comparison_v5_1_pdf_path.description: Path with SHA in filename per AC-V51-POLISH-1.

branch_base_sha_v5_1.description: Branch base SHA of wave6-trevino-v5.1 on wave5-v5.0-figures HEAD (Arch-1-#5).

branch_base_sha_v5_1_recorded_iso.description: ISO timestamp recorded within 60s of branch creation, before any commit (Arch-1-#5).

mv1a_new_canonical_run_id.description: Run-id of the new MV1a canonical run directory.

mv1a_parity_report_path.description: Path to parity_vs_v4_2.json for MV1a (alias for parity_vs_v4_2_path).

mv2_r_parity_report_path.description: Path to R-Python parity report (alias for parity_report_r_python_path).

mv3_chromvar_module_sha.description: SHA-256 of workflow/modular/modules/chromvar.py at ledger write time.

mv3_tf_network_module_sha.description: SHA-256 of workflow/modular/modules/tf_network.py at ledger write time.

mv3_gwas_module_sha.description: SHA-256 of workflow/modular/modules/gwas_overlay.py at ledger write time.

polish_pdf_v5_1_symlink_history.description: Append-only history of comparison PDF symlink swaps (v5.1 entry appended; v5.0.4 entry preserved).

hv1_geo_dataset_sha.description: Aggregate SHA of all GEO supplementary files downloaded for HV1.

hv1_layer3_metrics_path.description: Path to quantitative_metrics/ directory containing per-figure metric JSONs.

hv2_best_wnn_ari.description: Best WNN ARI found by sweep (alias for wnn_post_fix_ari).

cell_figure_use_acknowledgment_path.description: Path to signed acknowledgment file (90-day window expiring 2026-08-15).
